Class OpenTime

java.lang.Object
com.andreibel.server.entity.OpenTime
public class OpenTime extends Object

OpenTime entity class.

this class is used to represent the order entity in the database.

Attributes:

PK - id: int
C - SpatialDate: Date
C - SpatialDate: Time
C - closeTime: Time
C - interval: int

DDL

    create table OpenTime
(
    id          int auto_increment
        primary key,
    SpatialDate date        null,
    title       varchar(50) null,
    openTime    time        null,
    closeTime   time        null,
    `interval`  int         null
);
